column1: # One row per tool name; several names may share one image (bcftools and
# samtools both run from `hts`). Built by .github/workflows/containers.yml from
# containers/<recipe>, fetched by digest by workflow/scripts/fetch_containers.sh.
# digest = the SIF's sha256 (also its registry digest); built_from = the commit
# its recipe was built from. PENDING until the first containers workflow run;
# then copy both from its job summary here in a reviewed commit. Any job needing
# a PENDING image fails on the missing path.
# No literal hash character in any cell: this file is read with pandas comment="#".

column6: truvari version && python -c 'import pyabpoa, pywfa, pysam'
